description: Historical Polymarket trade query with filters (market, wallet, side, min_usd) plus per-wallet aggregation: every CLOB fill with wallet, size, price, USD value, market title and tx hash — for agents tracking flow and smart money. Source: Polymarket public trades API (keyless). $0.01 USDC x402 Base. Input: {"market": "bitcoin", "min_usd": 1000, "limit": 25, "agregar_por_wallet": true} (all optional). [x402: 0.01 USDC per call on Base; first 2 calls free]

input.description: product parameters (JSON or text). Example: {"market": "bitcoin", "min_usd": 1000, "limit": 25, "agregar_por_wallet": true}
